visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a cooked king oyster mushroom being pulled apart by two hands, revealing melted white cheese stretching between the pieces. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) Extreme close-up of a mushroom being cut with scissors, causing clear liquid to squirt out onto a pink plate. (3) Sequence of hands preparing raw mushrooms: poking a hole with a white straw, inserting a long cheese stick, brushing with green oil, and sprinkling black pepper. (4) The mushrooms are placed inside a white air fryer with a transparent window. A finger presses the digital touch panel setting it to 200 degrees. (5) Shots of mushrooms browning through the air fryer window with orange light. A pair of tongs flips the mushrooms midway. (6) A man in a cream sweatshirt and a woman in a grey hoodie stand in a kitchen, excitedly opening the air fryer. They take out the finished dark brown mushrooms. (7) Close-up of the couple eating the mushrooms, pulling the cheese several inches long with their teeth. Liquid is shown dripping into a black bowl. (8) The man stands alone in the kitchen holding the white air fryer, gesturing toward it while animated price text overlays appear on the screen. (9) Series of cutaway shots showing the interior of the air fryer, its 6.5L capacity with fried chicken legs inside, and technical certification documents.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man is wearing a cream-colored sweatshirt with 'MULTITYPE' and an Ultraman graphic. The woman has long brown hair and is wearing a light green crop top under a grey zip-up hoodie.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern residential kitchen with white cabinets, a black countertop, a microwave, and various kitchen utensils visible on shelves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM starts immediately with a bright synthesizer melody. A male voice speaks rapidly and excitedly about a hidden recipe. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to the tutorial. The narrator delivers instructional phrases with high pitch variability. (3) A 'click' SFX sounds as the air fryer drawer opens, followed by a 'bubble' SFX as variety text appears. (4) During the tasting, distinct squishing and slurping sounds are audible, followed by loud 'Wow' vocalizations from the woman and cheering from the man. (5) A rhythmic 'ding' SFX punctuates each price reveal. The male voice becomes more authoritative and loud, shouting 'Bùyòng!' (No need!) repeatedly. (6) Fast-paced product feature description with a background of constant energetic music. (7) Final loud shout 'Mǎi huíjiā!' (Buy it home!) followed by a sudden heavy thud SFX to end the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Cooking Tutorial -> Taste Test -> Product Pitch -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses an intriguing 'hidden' cooking recipe for cheese-stuffed king oyster mushrooms as a hook to capture attention before pivoting into a direct sales pitch for a KINYO brand air fryer at a discounted group-buy price.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is dedicated to listing technical specifications, price discounts, and warranty information for the KINYO air fryer.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends short-form viral cooking content with traditional infomercial techniques, utilizing high information density and fast pacing.
